cases.name: bowling-trail-history
cases.evidence: 1B12C0 appends a 20-byte entry to the 32-slot history at 8020A0, updates its UV clock and ages the other entries before drawing at 1B14DC. Those operations belong to bowling rule time. The prefix stops at the first drawing helper, 28580, without replacing a graphics service.

cases.name: goal-flight-camera
cases.evidence: The supplied goal capture selects camera type 15 at camera+1E: B00D0 through 56A0CC. B75B1 held this coupled orbit, velocity and lagged-target controller between rule ticks. The original complete recurrence now commits on rule ticks, while its prospective next rule is evaluated on private camera/ball records for each scene. The shared camera helper tracks controller ownership; original whole-tick results and pauses remain unchanged.

cases.name: stopped-replay-stage
cases.evidence: The captured group 1 records state 1 (stopped). Integer replay samples 61 and 62 both reconstruct stage clock 599. Before correction, 27A740 returned 598.5 at 61.5, making stationary geometry oscillate between ticks. Fractional reconstruction must use the recorded state, including stopped, reverse and double-speed codes. 249710 has the same boundary for saved replays.

cases.name: rolling-upright-recovery
cases.evidence: 88CA0 recovers the ape's up vector with a 5-degree original 60 Hz turn. 88F58's 0.01 threshold is 1-dot(up,pose), an approximately 8.1-degree snap cone. Leaving that cone unchanged snapped a captured-model six-degree lean upright in the first 360 Hz scene. The independently bounded slope below allows the original one-degree snap surplus, but rejects that premature snap. It exercises the original quaternion/matrix/recovery code, not only the threshold helper.

cases.name: hud-fallout-spin
cases.evidence: 4D050 is recurring drawing with persistent expression, delay and angular state. Counter 6EB6F8 and the delay/blink state must retain rule cadence. Fallout spin is the capped original sum of 32*n turn units per tick. Below saturation, the original semi-implicit sum is -16*t*(t+1). The prefix stops before the first 75400 submission.

cases.name: hud-idle-spin
cases.evidence: 4D464's default 0x180-unit head turn is elapsed motion, while 4D0BE and the expression/delay/blink transitions use original rule ticks. The scene angle retains fractional integer units, including uneven intervals.

cases.name: hud-paused-spin

The six-degree captured-model recovery prefix exercises the shared party-game path.

cases.name: hud-fallout-cap
cases.evidence: The 4D428 clamp caps the original fallout turn at 4096 units from counter 128 onward. Starting at 126 crosses that boundary, including fractional and catch-up intervals, without wrapping the observed signed angle.
